verdict.rationale: Whether user data is excluded from AI training is a fair privacy question for any service that holds personal data, including a government tax portal, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions AI training, data-use opt-outs, or a related privacy setting. The communication-channel management item is an unrelated feature, and the llms.txt probe concerns agent documentation, not data use.
